profileText: a Delegate from Georgia; born in that State in 1740; completed preparatory studies; served in the Revolutionary War as aide-de-camp to General Nathanael Greene; engaged in mercantile pursuits in Savannah, Ga.; member of the state house of representatives in 1786; Delegate to the Confederation Congress, 1787; delegate to the Federal Constitutional Convention in 1787; was an original member and vice president of the Society of the Cincinnati; trustee of Chatham County Academy at the time of his death; died in Savannah, Ga., December 10, 1789.
